dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Saint Martin’s Island Cox’Bazar District, Chittagong Division  as of 15 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code TC20230510BGD, GDACS Id: 1000970** This map illustrates satellite-based damage assessment in Saint Martin’s Island Cox’Bazar District, Chattogram Division detected by using a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 15 May 2023. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT identified 211 affected and potentially affected structures. Taking into account the pre-building footprints provided by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap, this represents about 17% of the total number of structures affected in Saint Martin’s Island. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
